parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

><notice>

This field is of the Long type. During serialization and deserialization, precision may be lost. Make sure that the value does not exceed 9007199254740991.

</notice>

parameters.name: Filters
parameters.description:
The filter conditions.

> Error log filtering is supported only for RDS MySQL, RDS PostgreSQL, PolarDB for MySQL, PolarDB for PostgreSQL, and PolarDB for PostgreSQL (compatible with Oracle).

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The filter parameter. Set the value to filters.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The content of the error log to filter.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: Role
parameters.description:
The node role:

- db
- mongos

> This parameter is supported only for ApsaraDB for MongoDB instances.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds.

><notice>

This field is of the Long type. During serialization and deserialization, precision may be lost. Make sure that the value does not exceed 9007199254740991.

</notice>
